correctness.rationale: The replacement RESULT.md corrects the prior-work comparison; it leaves the mathematical statement and proof unchanged. Positional contraction with a common stationary drive/reset clock gives the bounded unique stationary law. For n≥1, generator resetting contributes -r times each moment monomial even when the monomial includes S; b_0=m is unaffected. As a separate exact route, the dimensionless stationary position is the integral of e^(-s)S(-s) up to the independent exponential reset age (infinite at t=0). Two-time correlations are m²+(1-m²)e^(-g gap); the three-time correlation for consecutive gaps p,q is m³+m(1-m²)(e^(-gp)+e^(-gq)-e^(-g(p+q)). Integrating on ordered times and centering symbolically gave all five quartic coefficients, using independent_recheck.py, reset_moments. The frozen SymPy script was inspected, not run. For 0<z<1, c_2-c_1>0; for z≥3/4 c_3>0, and otherwise c_3≤0 forces g≤(6-8z)/(3-z), where the increasing c_2 is at most the strictly negative threshold value in the proof. Thus the nonzero coefficients have only one sign change, with c_0<0 and c_4>0, so the positive root is simple and unique. The denominator is positive for t≥0. At any finite t, holding either orientation with no reset over a time longer than log(2)/kappa gives stationarity positive probability on each side of zero, proving nonzero variance. This justifies the standardized-skewness statement. The symmetric case has reflection symmetry and is excluded from the reversal theorem.
